behaviour: C1: every reaction write that changes stored rows (applyOptimistic, applyOptimisticRemoval, rollbackOptimistic, applyInboundRumor; DM and group; own and incoming) posts store-changed {store:'reactions', id:<thread namespace key>} once, after the IDB write settles (also after a rejected, indeterminate write). No-op writes post nothing.
C2: clearDmReactionsForPeer and purgeStrangerDmReactions post one reactions notice per deleted thread key after delMany settles.
C3: on receipt, only the announced thread is re-read into the cache and only its listeners fire; a thread neither cached nor subscribed is not read; unscoped notices refresh nothing.

C4: the re-read is queued on the thread's write queue (after in-flight writes of this tab), so a removal in flight is never revived; a later write queued behind a refresh stays serialised; a cold loadReactions never overwrites a newer cache entry.
C5: the refresh never writes, never posts, never rejects; a failed re-read keeps the cache and notifies nobody; it is skipped while clearAllReactions runs.
C6: a failed post never fails the reaction write (postStoreChanged never throws).
non_goals: No cross-tab write coordination (two tabs' concurrent read-modify-writes of one thread can still lose an update; multi-tab design S1).
No account-switch notice from clearAllReactions (whole-account wipe; other tabs are out of scope of this finding).
No change to the local cache on a rejected IDB write (pre-existing; see open questions).
No new e2e spec (unit two-tab test covers the mechanism; the lead may add a dm-*/groups-* two-page spec).
deviations_from_finding: Notices are posted after the IDB write settles, including a rejected one (indeterminate != rejection), unlike the S0 writers which post only on success; the receiver only re-reads stored state, so this is safe.
Scope extended to the peer wipes (clearDmReactionsForPeer, purgeStrangerDmReactions) and the cold-load overwrite guard in loadReactions (same stale-cache class).
